sip-calculator.html.sub: Forecast your future wealth based on monthly investments, expected returns, and time horizons.
sip-calculator.html.intro_p: Systematic Investment Plans are the cornerstone of long-term wealth creation. Our SIP Calculator helps you visualize how small monthly contributions can grow into a significant corpus over time through the power of compounding. Use the interactive sliders to test different scenarios in seconds.
steps: Input your monthly SIP amount, expected annual return rate, and the duration of your investment.
Review the breakdown of Total Invested, Estimated Returns, and Total Value in the visual results.
Adjust the sliders to see how increasing your tenure by even one year can significantly boost your final wealth.
faq: How are SIP returns calculated?
We use the compound interest formula specifically for periodic installments (SIP) to give you an accurate forecast.
Is the 12% return guaranteed?
No, mutual fund returns vary. 12% is a common average used for long-term equity projections.
Is my financial planning private?
Yes. All investment math is performed locally. We do not track or save your financial figures.
Can I calculate for a Lumpsum investment?
This tool is for SIPs. For one-time investments, look for our Lumpsum Calculator in the Finance section.

ppf-calculator.html.desc_meta: Calculate your Public Provident Fund (PPF) maturity amount and total interest earned. Updated for current interest rates. Free online PPF calculator.
ppf-calculator.html.sub: Plan your retirement with precise calculations for your Public Provident Fund contributions.
ppf-calculator.html.intro_p: The Public Provident Fund (PPF) is one of India's most popular long-term savings schemes. Our PPF Calculator simplifies the 15-year maturity math, accounting for annual contributions and the current interest rate. It's the perfect tool for secured financial planning.
steps: Enter your annual PPF contribution (up to 1.5 Lakhs per year).
The tool uses the standard 15-year tenure to project your final maturity amount.
Review the year-by-year table to see how interest builds up over the entire period.
faq: What is the current PPF interest rate?
PPF rates are set by the government quarterly. Our tool uses the standard prevailing rate for current projections.
What is the maximum PPF limit?
Currently, you can invest up to ₹1,50,000 per financial year in a PPF account.
Is PPF tax-free?
Yes, PPF falls under the EEE (Exempt-Exempt-Exempt) category in India, meaning investment, interest, and maturity are tax-free.
Can I extend my PPF beyond 15 years?
Yes, in blocks of 5 years. This calculator focuses on the initial 15-year maturity period.

loan-comparison-calculator.html.intro_h2: What is the Loan Comparison Calculator?
loan-comparison-calculator.html.intro_p: Choosing between banking offers can be confusing. Does a lower interest rate with a higher processing fee better than a higher rate with no fee? Our Comparison Calculator puts loan offers side-by-side, highlighting the winner based on the total cost of the loan.
steps: Enter the details for 'Loan Option 1' and 'Loan Option 2' in the respective columns.
Review the side-by-side comparison of Monthly EMI, Total Interest, and the Total Amount to be paid.
The better financial deal is automatically highlighted to help you make a faster decision.
faq: How to check which loan is cheaper?
Compare the 'Total Amount Payable' field. The loan with the lower total cost is financially cheaper, even if the EMI is slightly different.
Can I compare a car loan with a home loan?
Yes, you can compare any two reducing-balance loans by inputting their respective rates and tenures.
Is the comparison private?
Absolutely. Like all our tools, it runs locally. Your loan figures never leave your browser.
Should I focus on EMI or Total Interest?
While EMI affects your monthly budget, Total Interest shows the true cost of the loan over time. This tool shows both.

loan-eligibility-calculator.html.desc_meta: Find out your home or personal loan eligibility based on income and existing EMIs. Detailed report on loan limits. Free online eligibility checker.
loan-eligibility-calculator.html.sub: Get a realistic estimate of how much a bank might lend you based on your financial profile.
loan-eligibility-calculator.html.intro_h2: What is the Loan Eligibility Calculator?
loan-eligibility-calculator.html.intro_p: Before you apply for a loan, it's vital to know your borrowing limit. Our eligibility tool uses the standard FOIR (Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio) used by most banks to estimate your maximum loan amount, helping you set expectations before the paperwork starts.
steps: Enter your gross monthly income and any existing monthly EMI obligations.
Set your desired loan tenure and the current interest rate.
View your 'Estimated Loan Amount' instantly in the result hero section.
faq: How do banks calculate eligibility?
Banks typically ensure that your total monthly obligations (including the new loan) don't exceed 50-60% of your net income.
Will this affect my credit score?
No. This is a local simulator on WorldOfTools. We do not perform credit pulls or store your data.
How can I increase my loan eligibility?
Lowering existing debts (EMIs) or increasing the loan tenure are the two most common ways to boost your limit.
Is this accurate for home loans?
Yes, it provides a very close estimate for home, car, and personal loans based on standard banking formulas.

hash-generator.html.desc_meta: Generate secure file and text hashes (MD5, SHA256, etc.) instantly. Verify file integrity and passwords. Free, private, online hash generator.
hash-generator.html.sub: Create one-way cryptographic hashes for text or files using standard algorithms.
hash-generator.html.intro_p: Need to verify a file download or secure a piece of data? Our Hash Generator computes common cryptographic fingerprints (MD5, SHA1, SHA256, SHA512) simultaneously. It's an essential tool for developers and security-conscious users who need 100% private verification.
steps: Enter the text you want to hash, or upload a small file.
The tool will instantly display the hash values for all supported algorithms.
Click the 'Copy' icon next to any hash to used it for verification or storage.
faq: What is a hash function?
A hash is a unique digital fingerprint. Even a tiny change in the input results in a completely different hash output.
Can a hash be reversed?
No. Cryptographic hashes are one-way. You cannot 'extract' the original text from a hash string.
Is the hashing private?
Yes. All computations happen locally in your browser tab. Your input data is never sent to a server.
Which hash is most secure?
For general security, SHA256 or SHA512 are recommended. MD5 is useful for simple file integrity checks.
